description: Use for individual tax rulings by topic, for example rental income, crypto or IKE and IKZE. Individual tax rulings of the Polish tax information office (KIS) and municipal rulings on property tax, published in the EUREKA database of the Ministry of Finance, by topic: private rental (najem_prywatny), selling a flat and the housing relief (sprzedaz_nieruchomosci), IKE/IKZE (ike_ikze), crypto (kryptowaluty), shares, funds and dividends (inwestycje_pit38), sole proprietorship, lump-sum tax and IP Box (jdg_ryczalt), PIT reliefs (ulgi_pit), property tax (podatek_od_nieruchomosci). Returns counts per full week (series finwire_tax_rulings_pulse), provisions cited most often in the last 52 weeks and the newest rulings with signature, authority, dates, shortened thesis and a link to the full text. A ruling answers one taxpayer about their own case; it is not legal advice.

limit.description: Rulings to return for the topic, default 10.

topic.description: Topic; omit for all topics with counts and a few newest rulings.
